inspect-aws.--include-tag: Only include resources with this tag (format: key=value). Key matching is exact (case-sensitive). Value is a case-sensitive regex that performs partial matching (use ^value$ for exact match, or (?i)value for case-insensitive). Each key may only appear once. Include multiple times for AND logic.
